references.shows: Maker reference for the chosen instrument form and proportions.
Second view or guide for checking the fit of the tubing and the controls.

silhouette: Long paired slide with a narrow return bend below the forward-facing bell.
features: Two straight, parallel slide tubes with one U bend
Separate bell section with a rear return bend
Mouthpiece at the player end below the bell tube
Short stays between the slide tubes
iconFeatures: Two straight, parallel slide tubes with one U bend
Separate bell section with a rear return bend
avoid: Overlapping tubes that hide the principal bends
Detached or offset mouthpiece and bell
notes: Shows the modern form in the reference. The muted linework keeps the major tube bends distinct.

geometry.view: Side in closed or nearly closed position
geometry.proportions: Long straight lower slide reaches past the forward bell; the return at its tip is narrow.
geometry.partLayout: Maintain two parallel slide rails, a continuous U at their tip, and a distinct rear tuning bow joining slide assembly to the bell section.

documentedDimensions.value: 204.4 mm bell diameter and 12.7 mm bore; bell diameter is about 16 times the bore
